title: disk-hygiene policy overlay
description: A standing policy file (~/.claude/disk-hygiene.json, <project>/.claude/disk-hygiene.json) or an explicit --policy file. Layers apply in that order and only add: an overlay can disable or add hints, add protected path globs, and, at version 2, add rules. No overlay can weaken a hard guard. The one exception to only-add is the version 2 elevation opt-in. The engine loader (load_policy, apply_policy_overlay) enforces the constraints this schema cannot express: hint ids in a rule must exist in the merged hint set, additional hint ids must not collide with an existing id, and a project file may set elevation only to never.

disabled_hint_ids.description: Hint ids removed from the merged hint set.

additional_hints.description: Hints added to the merged set. Each id must be new.

additional_protected_path_globs.description: Globs whose matches are protected from deletion.

rules.description: Rules that decide what a hinted entry is preselected for. Rules match on hint id (an entry carries hints, not a class). Later layers append; when two rules match the same entry, the rule from the later layer wins.

elevation.description: Whether the clean skill may offer a UAC-elevated re-check and removal for approved-tier paths that handoff-verify reports contested with needs-elevation as the only reason. Windows only; never sudo. Defaults to never. The last layer that sets it wins, and only the user-global file or an explicit --policy may set uac-prompt.

entry_types.description: Entry kinds the hint matches. A hint that sets none matches every kind; link is a symlink or reparse point.

match.description: Exactly one of hint_id or hint_ids. Every named id must exist in the merged hint set.

min_age_basis.description: The timestamp min_age_days is measured from. Only mtime is supported.
